corrections.reason: Both visually in the zoomed image (6th-order ጽ and 6th-order ሕ) and grammatically after 'ወኮነ', the Ge'ez verbal noun is 'ጽሕፎ' ('its writing'), not the verb 'ጸሐፎ'.
The canonical Ge'ez colophon phrase translated in L07 as 'በሥጋ' is 'ዘበአጽዖግዮ' (with 6th-order ጽ, not 5th-order ጼ), as visible in the print.
